title: The Ashen Road
synopsis: Three holdings have burned in a month and the burning is walking inland. Emberwatch has one reeve, no soldiers, and a purse. You have the rest.

cast.name: Maera Vulk
cast.about: Third year in the office, second year without a garrison. Counts everything twice, including you.

cast.name: Oss Tallow
cast.about: Ran out of the Ash Warren ahead of the thing that took it. Would rather be paid than pitied.

cast.name: Sigrun Barrowkeep
cast.role: Keeper of the Barrow of Kings
cast.about: Has held the door of a dead king's house for longer than Emberwatch has existed.

chapters.title: Smoke on the Marches
chapters.intro: Riding in, you can smell the marches before you can see them.

journal: Three holdings gone in a month. The last one was close enough to Emberwatch to light its wall.

beats.speaker: maera
beats.title: The Reeve of Emberwatch
lines: "You're the ones who take work. Good. I have work and no soldiers, which is the whole of my situation."
"Goblins out of the Ash Warren have been burning holdings — except they haven't. They've been running through them. Something moved into that warren and put them on the road."
"Clear it out. I'll pay what the holdings would have paid in tax, which is insulting, and it's what I have."

choices.text: Name the price and we'll ride.

journal: Hired by Maera Vulk, on Emberwatch's coin.

choices.text: Insulting, you said. Say a number that isn't.

journal: The reeve paid sixty up front rather than argue. She will remember it.
You told the reeve no. The marches keep burning; the offer stays open.

beats.speaker: oss
beats.title: Oss Tallow, at the gate
lines: "You're the warren job. Listen — my lot didn't burn anything. We left. There's a thing in the deep gallery that came up out of the barrow road, and it walks in cinders."
"Kill it and I'll say so in front of the reeve. That's worth more to me than your coin, and about the same to you."

journal: Oss Tallow: a cinder-thing in the deep gallery, come up from the barrow road.

chapters.title: What the Goblins Were Running From
chapters.intro: Whatever it was in the warren came up from somewhere, and it left a road behind it.

beats.speaker: sigrun
beats.title: Sigrun Barrowkeep sends word
lines: A rider from the west, carrying a seal older than the holding she rode to.
"The Barrow of Kings is open. It was not opened from outside. Whatever walks out of it walks east, and east of it is you."
"I have held that door for ninety years. I would rather not hold it alone for the ninety-first."

journal: The Barrow of Kings stands open — from the inside.
Somebody else is working the barrow road, and they are not there to shut it.

chapters.title: The Thing Under the Scar
chapters.intro: Sigrun's barrow was a door. Doors have somebody on the other side of them.

beats.speaker: sigrun
beats.title: What the keeper knew
lines: "The dead in my barrow were not walking. They were being called, and the call came from the Wyrmscar."
"There is a thing asleep under that burn, and it has started dreaming about the vale."
"I can give you the road in. I cannot give you the way out; nobody has needed one."

journal: Sigrun gave you the road into the Wyrmscar.

choices.text: We'll come back armed for it.

journal: Three hundred gold went on supply for the Wyrmscar road.

quest.title: End what sleeps in the Wyrmscar

beats.speaker: maera
beats.title: The vale holds
lines: "Nothing has burned in three weeks. People have started arguing about taxes again, which is how I know it's over."
"Emberwatch owes you a road, a wall and a season. Take the road; we're keeping the wall."

journal: The Ashen Road is closed. Emberwatch still stands, which was the whole of the job.
